channel.title: Food Service Director - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Service Director (foodservicedirector.com)

item.title: Aramark Collegiate Hospitality launches The Gathering Place for Gen Z students
item.description: The Gen Z-focused campus dining concept includes gaming lounges, interactive chef tables, hydration stations and other customizable features.

item.title: Paradies Lagardère’s high-flying new airport concepts balance local and national brands
item.description: The North American restaurateur and retailer’s new arrivals across major U.S. airports include CAVA, Berkshire Farm to Flight, Local Green and more.

item.title: Are robots the most popular “students” on campus? New data says yes
item.description: Delivery robots by Starship are steadily beep-booping along sidewalks and are increasingly seen by students as friendly helpers.

item.title: Hawaii lawmakers want to bring universal free school meals to the state
item.description: Also in this week's K-12 legislative update: An Indiana bill would ban certain ingredients from school meals and a bill in Florida would establish a school food waste pilot.

item.title: The busy season blueprint: How smart operators plan, staff and stay sane in chaos
item.description: James Ubillos, resident district manager for Sodexo at the University of South Dakota, January's Foodservice Operation of the Month, shares how he and his team stay organized and grounded during their busy season in October.

item.title: Double Decker Mexican Flatbread Pizza
item.description: This south-of-the-border inspired flatbread recipe from General Mills Foodservice features not one but two types of refried beans and the classic taste of tacos.

item.title: Double Bean Biscuit Pupusa with Cilantro Lime Crema
item.description: This meatless version of El Salvador's 'hot pocket' from General Mills Foodservice features beans, chilis, onions and cheese wrapped in biscuit dough.

item.title: Slow-Cooked Butter Beans with Collard Greens, Pork Belly & Cajun Tomato Sauce
item.description: This down-home recipe from HHS Chef Brittney Horn is a hearty, spicy celebration that includes a drizzle of maple hot sauce syrup on top.

item.title: Recipe report: Count on beans for warming up winter menus
item.description: When temperatures get down to the single digits, it's time to crank up the heat with these boldly bean-forward recipes, including a nostalgic Mexican pizza flatbread, El Salvadoran pupusas, Cajun beans with collard greens and more.

item.title: Moving the needle on ultra-processed foods in schools could take a decade
item.description: After the 2025-2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans asked consumers to avoid highly processed foods for the first time, school nutrition operators are bracing for major changes to the School Nutrition Standards which will likely require school nutrition programs to restrict the amount of ultra-processed foods they serve.
